dialogue.content: 今日はよろしくお願いします。ぴったり13時から、始めさせていただだこうかと思います。よろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Thank you for coming today. It's exactly 1:00 PM, so I'd like to begin now. Is that okay with you?

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。では、始めていきますね。（よろしくお願いします）
dialogue.English: Thank you. Well then, let's get started. (Thank you.)

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: こんにちは、相談員です。ご相談の前に、差支えなければ、相談者さんの呼び名（匿名で大丈夫です）と年代を教えてもらえたら嬉しいです。
dialogue.English: Hello, I'm a counselor. Before we begin, if you don't mind, could you please tell me what you'd like to be called (an anonymous name is fine) and your age group?

dialogue.content: はるか、高校１年です
dialogue.English: Haruka. I'm a first-year in high school.

dialogue.content: はるかさんですね、お名前教えてくださってありがとうございます。今日はどんなご相談でお越しいただきましたか？
dialogue.English: Haruka, right? Thank you for sharing your name. What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 友達と何となくうまく行ってない感じで・・
dialogue.English: I feel like things aren't going so well with my friends...

dialogue.content: 友達と何となくうまく行ってない感じがするんですね。よろしければ、そうお考えになったきっかけを、もう少し詳しく教えていただいてもいいですか？
dialogue.English: I see—you feel like things aren't going well with your friends. If you're comfortable, could you tell me a bit more about what led you to feel that way?

dialogue.content: 2ヶ月前に彼氏ができたんです。あっちから告白されて
dialogue.English: I got a boyfriend two months ago. He was the one who confessed to me.

dialogue.content: ええ（このままお聞きしていますね）
dialogue.English: I see. (Please continue, I'm listening.)

dialogue.content: そしたら、仲良かった友達が何となく素っ気なくなってきて・・
dialogue.English: Then, the friend I was close with started acting kind of distant...

dialogue.content: その子も彼のこと好きだったのかもしれないけど、聞きにくくて・・・
dialogue.English: Maybe she liked him too, but it's hard to ask...

dialogue.content: そしたら、他の子達もだんだん素っ気なくなってきて・・
dialogue.English: And then the other girls also gradually started acting distant...

dialogue.content: ええ、ええ。
dialogue.English: I see, I see.

dialogue.content: かげで私の悪口いってるみたいで
dialogue.English: It seems like they're talking badly about me behind my back.

dialogue.content: すごく嫌な気持ちなんです
dialogue.English: It makes me feel really awful.

dialogue.content: 素っ気ない態度や、悪口いってるみたいなんですね。それは嫌な気持ちになりますよね。
dialogue.English: So they're being distant, and it seems like they're talking behind your back. That must be a very unpleasant feeling.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 相手から告白されて彼氏ができのに、友達が素っ気なくなってきてしまったなんて、
dialogue.English: You got a boyfriend after he confessed to you, but now your friends are acting distant—

dialogue.content: はるかさんも困ってしまいますよね。
dialogue.English: That must be very troubling for you, Haruka.

dialogue.content: はい、なんかもうダルクて学校行くの嫌です
dialogue.English: Yes, I just feel so drained, I don't want to go to school.

dialogue.content: それは、だるくなると思います。友達も素っ気なかったり、悪口いってるように思うと、よけいに行く気がなくなっちゃいますよね。
dialogue.English: I can understand why you'd feel drained. When your friends are being distant and you think they're saying bad things about you, it makes you want to go to school even less, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's exactly it.

dialogue.content: 例えば、どんなことで素っ気ないなって、感じられるんですか？
dialogue.English: For example, what specific things make you feel they're being distant?

dialogue.content: 前はお昼食べたり、学校の帰りにどっか寄ったりする時必ず誘われてたのに、最近は私がトイレ行ってる間にかいなくなっちゃったり、
dialogue.English: Before, they would always invite me to have lunch or to go somewhere after school, but recently, they'll just disappear while I'm in the restroom,

dialogue.content: 向こうから話しかけてこなくなりました
dialogue.English: and they've stopped initiating conversations with me.

dialogue.content: これまではよく誘われたり話しかけいてたのにそれもなくて、はるかさんが席外している間にいなくなっちゃうんですね、
dialogue.English: So, they used to invite you and talk to you often, but that's stopped, and now they disappear when you're away from your seat.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: それは本当に、学校に行きづらくなりますね。傷つきます。
dialogue.English: That would certainly make it difficult to go to school. That's very hurtful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: はるかさんは、その、友達が帰っちゃった時、どんなお気持ちだったんですか。
dialogue.English: Haruka, when your friends left like that while you were away, how did you feel?

dialogue.content: 泣きたくなりました
dialogue.English: I felt like crying.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか…それは、泣きたくもなりますよね。
dialogue.English: I see... It's understandable that you'd feel like crying.

dialogue.content: 何でそんなふうにされるのかわかんないです
dialogue.English: I don't understand why they're treating me this way.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、はるかさんに素っ気なくする、理由が分からないですよね。
dialogue.English: Right—you don't know the reason they're being distant with you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 学校行くのしんどいです
dialogue.English: It's hard to go to school.

dialogue.content: ええ、このような状況で、本当にお辛いと思います、
dialogue.English: Yes, I can imagine this situation is very painful for you.

dialogue.content: よく、ここで話してくださったなって、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you so much for opening up and talking about it here.

dialogue.content: あ、はい
dialogue.English: Oh, yes.

dialogue.content: はるかさんは、友達と以前のように仲良くしたいというお気持ちなのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Haruka, do you want to be on good terms with your friends again, like before?

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, I do.

dialogue.content: ここまでの状況を少し整理すると、
dialogue.English: Let me summarize the situation so far.

dialogue.content: 相手から告白されて彼氏ができのに、友達が素っ気なくなってきてしまって、前はお昼食べたり、学校の帰りにどっか寄ったりする時必ず誘われてたのに、
dialogue.English: You got a boyfriend after he confessed his feelings, but your friends have become distant. They used to always invite you to have lunch or go somewhere after school,

dialogue.content: それがなくなってしまって、はるかさんは本当は友達と仲良くしたいと考えていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: but that has stopped, and you really want to be on good terms with them again. Is that right?

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: どうしたらいいのって、思いますよね。いまの状況ははるかさんにとってとても辛いと思うので、一緒に考えていけたらと思います。
dialogue.English: It's natural to wonder what to do. I know this is a very painful situation for you, so I'd like us to think it through together.

dialogue.content: はい、おねがいします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: まず、差し支えなければ、思い当たる出来事というのは、彼氏ができたこと、それ以外に何か考えられますか？
dialogue.English: First, if you don't mind, besides getting a boyfriend, is there anything else that comes to mind that might have caused this?

dialogue.content: それがわかんないんです。彼氏は他の学校で毎日会うわけじゃないし、その子達が気に触るようなこと言った覚えもなくて
dialogue.English: That's the thing, I don't know. My boyfriend goes to a different school, so we don't see each other every day, and I can't remember saying anything that would have upset them.

dialogue.content: なるほど。そうなんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that's how it is.

dialogue.content: 彼氏ができたことだけお友達に伝えられた感じですか？
dialogue.English: Did you just tell your friends that you got a boyfriend?

dialogue.content: はい、言いました
dialogue.English: Yes, I did.

dialogue.content: この前、なんか私悪いことしたっけ？って聞いたんですけど、別にーって言われました
dialogue.English: The other day I asked them, "Did I do something wrong?" but they just said, "Not really."

dialogue.content: 別にー、ですか。素っ気ない言葉ですね。それを聞いていたはるかさんが傷つかれたんじゃないかと心配です。
dialogue.English: "Not really," huh. That's a very dismissive thing to say. I'm worried that hearing that must have hurt you.

dialogue.content: 傷つきました
dialogue.English: It did.

dialogue.content: もういやです
dialogue.English: I can't take it anymore.

dialogue.content: 学校行くのつらいです
dialogue.English: It's painful to go to school.

dialogue.content: 本当にそうですよね。せっかく仲良くしたいのに、学校に行かれるの、もう辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I completely understand. You want to be on good terms with them, but going to school has become so painful for you.

dialogue.content: LINEも既読スルーです
dialogue.English: They even leave my LINE messages on read.

dialogue.content: 誰も頼れないです
dialogue.English: I have no one to turn to.

dialogue.content: 既読スルーですか、それも傷つきますよね。誰かに頼るのも難しい状況なんですね、、
dialogue.English: Left on read, too... that's hurtful as well. It sounds like it's hard to lean on anyone right now.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 友達とは、彼氏がいない頃はそういったことはなく、仲が良かったのでしょうか。
dialogue.English: Before you had a boyfriend, were you on good terms with your friends, without any of these issues?

dialogue.content: はい、仲良くつるんでました
dialogue.English: Yes, we hung out together and got along well.

dialogue.content: 友人の間で既読スルーとか、のけものにされる人とか、いなかったんですね。
dialogue.English: So there was no one in your group of friends who was ignored or left out like this?

dialogue.content: いませんでした
dialogue.English: No, there wasn't.

dialogue.content: 私の何が悪いんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What's wrong with me?

dialogue.content: わかんないです
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: ここまでお伺いしていて、はるかさんは全く悪くないように思います。
dialogue.English: From what you've told me so far, it doesn't seem like you've done anything wrong at all, Haruka.

dialogue.content: 彼氏ができたって自慢したこともないし、いやなこと言った覚えもないんです
dialogue.English: I never bragged about getting a boyfriend, and I don't remember saying anything mean.

dialogue.content: ええ。こんな状況でも友達と仲良くされたいっって考える優しいはるかさんが、
dialogue.English: Right. You're kind, Haruka—you still want to get along with your friends even in this situation,

dialogue.content: 何か友達を大きく傷つけるようなこと、思い当たらないんじゃないかと思います。
dialogue.English: so I don't think you would do anything to deeply hurt your friends without realizing it.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 友達と距離を取る、という選択肢もありますが、どう感じられますか？
dialogue.English: One option would be to take some distance from your friends. How would that feel to you?

dialogue.content: 今は距離取られちゃってる感じなんです。さびしいです
dialogue.English: Right now, it feels like they're the ones who have distanced themselves from me. I feel lonely.

dialogue.content: 今まで楽しかったんです
dialogue.English: We used to have so much fun together.

dialogue.content: なるほど。はるかさんから距離を取るのはちょっとさびしく思われるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So the idea of you distancing yourself from them feels lonely to you.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 今までみたいに普通に楽しくしていたいです
dialogue.English: I just want things to be fun and normal again, like before.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、これまでのように仲良くされたいですよね。
dialogue.English: Of course. You want to get along like you used to.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 例えば、こんなに辛い思いをしている、ってお友達に伝えることは、あまり考えられですか？
dialogue.English: For example, have you considered telling your friends how much this is hurting you?

dialogue.content: 伝えても既読スルーされるだけかなって思います
dialogue.English: I feel like even if I tell them, they'll just leave me on read.

dialogue.content: 伝えても意味がない、と感じていらっしゃるんですね。
dialogue.English: So you feel like there's no point in telling them.

dialogue.content: 意味がないっていうか、受け入れてくれないんじゃないかと思います
dialogue.English: It's not that it's pointless... I just don't think they would accept it.

dialogue.content: なるほど、受け入れてくれないんじゃないかと・・・
dialogue.English: I see, you feel they wouldn't be receptive...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 先ほど、誰に頼れないという話がありましたが、彼氏さんとはこのお話はされたのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Earlier, you mentioned you have no one to turn to. Have you spoken to your boyfriend about this?

dialogue.content: 少し話しました。でも気にするなよって。女ってめんどくセーなって
dialogue.English: I've talked to him a little about it. But he just said, "Don't worry about it," and "Girls are so annoying."

dialogue.content: 彼は部活で忙しくて、告ってきたのにあんまりしょっちゅうは会えないんです
dialogue.English: He's busy with his club activities, so even though he was the one who asked me out, we can't see each other very often.

dialogue.content: そう言われて、はるかさんは彼氏さんに何ておっしゃったんですか。
dialogue.English: When he said that, what did you say to him, Haruka?

dialogue.content: あんまり会えないんですね…。
dialogue.English: So you can't see him very often...

dialogue.content: しょうがないじゃん。悩んでるんだよって言ったんですけど、そしたら、そのうち元通りになるよって
dialogue.English: I told him, "I can't help it. I'm really worried about this." But then he just said, "It'll go back to normal eventually."

dialogue.content: 焦るなっていわれました
dialogue.English: He told me not to rush things.

dialogue.content: そのうち元通りになると、焦るなって言われたんですね。よろしければ、この状況になってから、どれくらい経つのか教えてもらえないでしょうか。
dialogue.English: He told you it will go back to normal eventually and not to rush things. If you don't mind telling me, how long has this situation been going on?

dialogue.content: 12月の初めくらいからです
dialogue.English: Since around the beginning of December.

dialogue.content: じゃあもう2か月も、はるかさんは1人で頑張ってこられたんですね。大変でしたね。
dialogue.English: So for two months now, you've been dealing with this all by yourself. That must have been so difficult.

dialogue.content: はい、最初は何となくおかしいなって思ってたくらいなんですけど、今は本当に学校行くの憂鬱です
dialogue.English: Yes. At first I just thought something felt a little off, but now I really dread going to school.

dialogue.content: ええ、本当にそうだと思います。はるかさん、これは大切なことなので伝えておかなければならないのですが、
dialogue.English: Yes, I can really understand that. Haruka, this is important, so I should let you know—

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: この状況は、一般的にいじめと捉えられます。親も、学校も、対応が求められるような、そんな段階になっているのではないかと、思います。
dialogue.English: This situation can generally be considered bullying. I believe it has reached a stage where it requires a response from both your parents and the school.

dialogue.content: いじめですか？
dialogue.English: Bullying?

dialogue.content: いじめ防止対策推進法という法律があって、
dialogue.English: There's a law called the Act for the Promotion of Bullying Prevention Measures,

dialogue.content: 学校の対応が求められる、そんな案件なのではと思います。
dialogue.English: and I believe this is a case where the school is required to take action.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね・・・
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: 学校は休んでも大丈夫なので、このことをまずは家族か信頼できる先生に伝えることはできますか？
dialogue.English: It's okay to take a break from school. Is it possible for you to first tell your family or a teacher you trust about this?

dialogue.content: スクールカウンセラーの先生でも構いません。
dialogue.English: The school counselor would also be a good person to talk to.

dialogue.content: 母親には何となく相談したんですが、そしたら他に友達作ればって言われました。
dialogue.English: I sort of mentioned it to my mother, and she just told me to make other friends.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。それだと、まずは学校関係者へお伝えして、保護者同伴での事実確認になると思います。
dialogue.English: I see. In that case, the first step would probably be to inform someone at the school, and then there would be a fact-checking meeting with your parents present.

dialogue.content: そんなに重大なことなんですか？！
dialogue.English: Is it really that serious?!

dialogue.content: おおごとにしたくありません
dialogue.English: I don't want to make a big deal out of it.

dialogue.content: 余計に友達といずらくなりそうです
dialogue.English: I'm afraid it will just make things more awkward with my friends.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。おおごとにしたくない、というお気持ちなんですね。
dialogue.English: I understand. You don't want to make a big deal out of it.

dialogue.content: ただ、前みたいに仲良くしたいだけです
dialogue.English: I just want to get along with them like before.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。いきなりすぎちゃいましたね。前みたいに仲良くしていけるように、考えていきましょう。
dialogue.English: I see. Maybe I jumped ahead too quickly. Let's think about how we can get back to being on good terms like before.

dialogue.content: 大事にするのは怖いです。ますます学校行きづらくなります
dialogue.English: Making it a big deal scares me. It would make going to school even harder.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。友達ににはるかさんの気持ちを分かってもらいたいなと思いますが、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.English: That makes sense. I think it would be good for your friends to understand how you feel. What do you think?

dialogue.content: はい、そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, I think so too.

dialogue.content: 気持ちを分かってもらうために、伝え方と、何を伝えるか、はとても重要だと思います。先ほどLINEは既読スルーされる可能性があると伺いましたので、他の伝え方でできそうなことって、思い当たりますか。
dialogue.English: To help them understand your feelings, how you communicate and what you communicate are very important. Since you mentioned they might ignore a LINE message, can you think of any other ways to communicate with them?

dialogue.content: わかりません
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 手紙で伝えたり、第3者に間に入ってもらったり、公園やお店で少し時間を作ってもらうとか、いかがでしょうか。
dialogue.English: How about writing a letter, asking a third person to mediate, or seeing if they can spare a little time to meet in a park or a café?

dialogue.content: 手紙、、、渡せるかな、、自信ないですけど、考えてみます
dialogue.English: A letter... I wonder if I could give it to them... I'm not confident, but I'll think about it.

dialogue.content: はるかさんの気持ちを伝えられるものなら、どんなものでも大丈夫ですよ。
dialogue.English: Any method that allows you to convey your feelings is perfectly fine, Haruka.

dialogue.content: 高校に入って休校が続いて、あんまり友達もたくさんできないでいたので、他の仲良い友達とかいないんです
dialogue.English: Since starting high school, we've had a lot of school closures, so I wasn't able to make many friends. I don't have any other close friends.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。すみません、お話しお時間足りなかったかもしれませんが、今日はそろそろ終了の時間になってしまいました。いかがでしたでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I see. I'm sorry if we didn't have enough time, but it's about time to end today's session. How was it for you?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。自分の気持ちを聞いてもらえたので、少しほっとしました。中学の時の友達に話してみようかと思いました。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I feel a little relieved just having someone listen to my feelings. I think I might try talking to a friend from middle school.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。中学の頃のお友達に、ぜひお話しされてみてくださいね。必要な時にはいつでも、ご相談ください。今日はご相談に来てくださり、本当にありがとうございました。それでは終了のメッセージを送りますね。
dialogue.English: I'm glad to hear that. Please do try talking to your friend from middle school. And please feel free to reach out for a consultation anytime you need. Thank you so much for coming in today. I will send the closing message now.

dialogue.content: （今日はありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you for today.)

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you.
